profile_text.body:
Technology Innovation Institute is a non-profit government lab founded in 2020. It is the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council and describes itself as a leading global scientific research center. Its Falcon LLM family is presented as generative large language models intended to make advanced AI accessible and available to everyone, everywhere. The institute also launched the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to advancing open-source generative AI models and building sustainable ecosystems around open-source projects.

The Falcon product line includes several models. Falcon is a UAE-hosted open-source LLM with Apache 2.0 licensing, sovereign AI, and Middle East data residency. The site lists Falcon-H1 and Falcon-E as the latest additions, with Falcon-H1 using a hybrid Transformer and Mamba architecture and claimed to outperform Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen. Falcon Perception is a multimodal model combining vision and language, Falcon Arabic targets Modern Standard Arabic and dialects, and Falcon H1R 7B is described as having advanced reasoning in mathematics, coding, logic, and instruction-following. Falcon Mamba 7B is called the first open source released State Space Language Model. Falcon 2 11B is described as open-source, multilingual, and multimodal with vision-to-language capabilities, and the site says it outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B and performs on par with Google Gemma 7B as independently verified by the Hugging Face Leaderboard. Falcon 180B has 180 billion parameters and was trained on 3.5 trillion tokens, while Falcon 40B has 40 billion parameters and was trained on one trillion tokens. Falcon 40B is described as the first home-grown open source LLM released with weights for research and commercial use.

No litigation or MCP server entries are listed for the institute. AI71, launched by Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council and VentureOne, is mentioned on the site as running a global call for proposals using Falcon 10B.
